title: Acton's estranged mother
what: Acton's estranged mother calls her a liar. Acton's brother and campaign called the ad a "despicable low," and Republicans in both parties criticized it. Shown here in CBS News Pittsburgh coverage.

title: Listen to This Shit
what: Ohioans react to audio of Husted saying people in poverty are "not very experienced at navigating the real world." Strong language.

title: Ohio Kids Deserve Better
what: A detransitioner suggests Brown supports gender surgeries for minors. Fact-checkers noted she had her surgery at 19, in Texas.

title: Republicans in Your Bathroom
what: An actor playing a Republican congressman confronts a girl in a school bathroom and questions whether she is "really a girl." Part of a buy of more than $1 million.

title: Ugly Record
what: AI-generated images show Ossoff at a salon while the narrator attacks his tax votes. There is no AI disclaimer, and Ossoff's campaign demanded the ad be pulled.

title: Pick Another Senator
what: Uses Hyde-Smith's "so many proteins" remark about beef prices. Mississippians say they'd rather pick another senator.

title: Chris Pappas Lied to Voters
what: Replays Pappas's 2020 denial of a relationship with an Amazon lobbyist, whom he later married. Pappas says it didn't affect his votes.

title: Country song
what: A country-song TV ad attacking Marshall.

title: In His Own Words (AI deepfake)
what: An AI-generated Talarico reads his old social media posts on transgender issues, race, religion and Planned Parenthood, along with commentary he never said. It's labeled "AI GENERATED."

title: A Different Kind of Experience
what: Turns Paxton's "no experience" attack into a joke by listing Paxton's securities fraud indictment, FBI bribery probe and impeachment by his own party, then pivots to Talarico's record. It drew over a million views within hours.

title: Jackson's temper
what: Claims Jackson hit a female colleague, citing a "water bottle incident." PolitiFact rated the claim false. Shown here in WMTW-TV's fact-check coverage.

title: The Face
what: Calls Husted "the face of data centers in Ohio" and blames the tax breaks he approved as lieutenant governor for rising utility bills.

title: Anti-Talarico attack ad
what: An attack ad against Talarico from a Texas PAC.

title: Acton's brother responds
what: Acton's brother backs up her account of their childhood and calls Ramaswamy "unfit to lead" after Ramaswamy's ad featuring their mother.
